name: VC Dimension of Tagged Singletons
details: The class shatters every singleton but no two-element set.
proof: Every coordinate has both labels among the class, so VC dimension is at least one.  No two ordinary coordinates can both be positive in one concept; an ordinary coordinate can be positive only together with its unique tag; and no two tag coordinates are simultaneously positive.  Thus every two-coordinate projection omits at least one of the four patterns, so VC dimension is exactly one.
